title.narrative: REACH-NW: Resilience Emergency Assistance for Communities in Humanitarian Assistance – Northwest, Myanmar

description.narrative: ltpgtThere is an ongoing humanitarian crisis in Northwest Myanmar due to ongoing conflict and economic instability. Violent clashes between Myanmar’s armed forces and opposition groups have led to widespread food insecurity, internal displacement, and skyrocketing prices for essential goods. Over 3 million internally displaced persons (IDPs) across Myanmar, including many in Magway, urgently require food, shelter, and protection. On March 28, 2025, Myanmar was subsequently hit with a massive 7.7 magnitude earthquake, creating an immediate need for relief for victims and furthering the humanitarian crisis in NW Myanmar.ltbrgtCSI, in collaboration with Heartland Union (HLU), will implement a 12-month project (May 1, 2025 – April 30, 2026) to address the immediate humanitarian needs of IDPs in the Salin, Tilin, and Yesagyo townships. CSI will also independently lead emergency earthquake aid in Sagaing (Sagaing Township) and Mandalay (Amarapura and Kyaukse Townships). The project will adopt a multi-sectoral approach, providing MPCA to earthquake victims in Sagaing and Mandalay- and, healthcare, WASH programming, and the establishment of a local Early Warning, Alerts, and Response System (EWARS) in Magway. ltbrgtCSI will lead the MPCA component, providing cash transfers of 360,000 MMK per household to 3,000 vulnerable earthquake victim households based on current CWG MEB guidance. This support will help families cover essential needs, such as food, shelter, and healthcare. CSI will also conduct training for staff and volunteers and perform Post-Distribution Monitoring (PDM) to evaluate the program’s impact.ltbrgtHLU will oversee the healthcare and WASH components, delivering 36 mobile clinic sessions and strengthening six fixed healthcare facilities across the region. The project aims to conduct 12,000 medical consultations and facilitate 480 emergency referrals, including funding for 120 life-saving surgeries. In addition, 36 community health awareness sessions will be organized on topics such as Explosive Ordnance Risk Education (EORE), nutrition, and public health.ltbrgtFor WASH, CSI will recruit and train HLU staff and volunteers to conduct hygiene awareness campaigns and HLU will distribute 5,300 hygiene kits to beneficiaries in Magway. Hygiene education, including menstrual health, will be integrated into the sessions to improve sanitation practices in the communities.ltbrgtCSI and HLU will collaborate to implement a localized EWARS framework for communicable diseases, which is vital given the region's vulnerability to natural disasters, political instability, and limited healthcare access. This system will enhance disease surveillance and response capabilities, improving inter-agency coordination and community awareness. Key activities will include system setup, needs assessments, data collection, and community engagement efforts. The goal is to strengthen the public health system and improve disease detection, response, and prevention in Magway and neighboring regions.ltbrgtThroughout the project, CSI will provide oversight and ensure that all interventions adhere to humanitarian standards and donor requirements. The project will be closely monitored through CSI’s MEAL system, which tracks progress, measures impact, and ensures compliance. Regular coordination between CSI and HLU will ensure that healthcare and WASH activities are aligned and effectively meet the needs of displaced populations. CSI will work closely with local clusters and other regional responders to ensure that all emergency earthquake aid is non-duplicated and coordinated. ltbrgtThis multi-sectoral approach will not provide essential services and improve health, dignity, and well-being in Magway, but will provide essential early response and recovery resources to earthquake victims in Sagaing and Mandalay. Through this partnership, CSI and HLU aim to offer life-saving support and ensure accountability and community involvement throughout the project’s implementation.ltbrgtltbrgtlt/pgt
